subject: Biology SL
title: Biology SL Paper 2 Section A Mock v1

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: A student investigated osmosis using equal cylinders of potato tissue placed in sucrose solutions for 40 minutes.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate the percentage change in mass of a potato cylinder that had an initial mass of 5.00 g and a final mass of 5.42 g.
markscheme: Mass change = 5.42 − 5.00 = 0.42 g.
Percentage change = 0.42 ÷ 5.00 × 100 = 8.4%.
parts.modelAnswer: The mass increased by 0.42 g, so the percentage change was 0.42 ÷ 5.00 × 100 = 8.4%.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 質量は0.42 g増加したので、百分率変化は0.42÷5.00×100＝8.4%です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Estimate the sucrose concentration at which there would be no net change in potato mass. Show how the data support your estimate.
markscheme: The zero-change concentration lies between 0.30 and 0.40 mol dm⁻³ because the mean change switches from positive to negative.
A reasonable interpolated estimate is about 0.35 mol dm⁻³ (accept approximately 0.34–0.36 mol dm⁻³).
markschemeJa: 平均質量変化が正から負へ変わるため、質量変化0の濃度は0.30と0.40 mol dm⁻³の間にある。
妥当な補間値は約0.35 mol dm⁻³（約0.34〜0.36 mol dm⁻³を可）。
parts.modelAnswer: The change crosses zero between 0.30 and 0.40 mol dm⁻³, so an estimate of about 0.35 mol dm⁻³ is reasonable.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 質量変化は0.30と0.40 mol dm⁻³の間で0をまたぐため、約0.35 mol dm⁻³と推定できます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain why the potato cylinders gain mass in the 0.10 mol dm⁻³ sucrose solution.
markscheme: The external solution has a higher (less negative) water potential than the potato cell contents.
Water moves into the cells by osmosis across partially permeable plasma membranes.
Water entry increases cell volume/turgor and therefore increases the mass of the tissue.
markschemeJa: 外液はジャガイモ細胞内より水ポテンシャルが高い（負の程度が小さい）。
水は部分透過性の細胞膜を通って浸透により細胞内へ移動する。
水の流入で細胞体積・膨圧が増え、組織の質量が増加する。
parts.modelAnswer: The dilute sucrose solution has a higher water potential than the cell contents. Water therefore enters the cells by osmosis through partially permeable membranes, increasing cell volume and tissue mass.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 薄いスクロース溶液は細胞内より水ポテンシャルが高いため、水が部分透過性膜を通って浸透し、細胞体積と組織の質量が増えます。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Suggest two variables that should be controlled when comparing the different sucrose concentrations.
markscheme: Control the size, surface area or initial mass of the potato cylinders.
Control another relevant variable such as immersion time, temperature, solution volume or the source of the potato tissue.
markschemeJa: ジャガイモ片の大きさ、表面積、初期質量などを一定にする。
浸漬時間、温度、溶液量、ジャガイモ組織の由来など別の適切な変数を一定にする。
parts.modelAnswer: Use potato cylinders with the same dimensions or initial mass and keep conditions such as immersion time and temperature constant.
parts.modelAnswerJa: ジャガイモ片の大きさや初期質量をそろえ、浸漬時間や温度なども一定にします。

parts.label: (e)
parts.question: Evaluate the reliability and precision of the estimate of the zero mass-change concentration using the data provided.
markscheme: The standard deviations are small relative to the changes at most concentrations, supporting reasonably consistent replicate measurements.
Only five replicates were used at each concentration, so additional replicates would give a more reliable mean.
The 0.10 mol dm⁻³ concentration intervals are relatively wide around the zero point; testing smaller intervals near 0.35 mol dm⁻³ would improve precision.
markschemeJa: 多くの濃度で標準偏差が平均変化量に比べて小さく、反復測定は比較的一貫している。
各濃度の反復は5本だけなので、反復数を増やすと平均値の信頼性が高まる。
0点付近の濃度間隔0.10 mol dm⁻³は比較的大きいため、0.35 mol dm⁻³付近を細かい間隔で調べると精度が上がる。
parts.modelAnswer: The small standard deviations suggest reasonably consistent repeats, but five replicates are limited. The concentration steps are also broad around the zero point. More replicates and smaller concentration intervals near 0.35 mol dm⁻³ would make the estimate more reliable and precise.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 標準偏差が小さいため反復は比較的一貫していますが、5反復は十分多いとはいえません。また0点付近の濃度間隔も粗いため、反復数を増やし0.35 mol dm⁻³付近を細かく測定すると信頼性と精度が上がります。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: The table gives observations for an unknown cell viewed with an electron microscope.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Identify whether the cell is prokaryotic or eukaryotic.
markscheme: Prokaryotic.
markschemeJa: 原核細胞。
parts.modelAnswerJa: この細胞は原核細胞です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain how two observations in the table support your answer to part (a).
markscheme: The cell has no membrane-bound nucleus; its DNA is in a nucleoid region.
It contains 70S ribosomes and/or lacks membrane-bound organelles, which is characteristic of prokaryotic cells.
markschemeJa: 膜で囲まれた核がなく、DNAは核様体領域にある。
70Sリボソームをもち、膜小器官がないことは原核細胞の特徴である。
parts.modelAnswer: The absence of a membrane-bound nucleus and membrane-bound organelles, together with 70S ribosomes, supports classification as a prokaryotic cell.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 膜で囲まれた核や膜小器官がなく70Sリボソームをもつことから、原核細胞と判断できます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain why a small cell size can help a cell exchange substances rapidly with its environment.
markscheme: Smaller cells have a larger surface area to volume ratio than geometrically similar larger cells.
A larger surface area relative to volume provides more membrane for exchange per unit of cytoplasm and reduces diffusion distances.
markschemeJa: 小さい細胞は相似な大きい細胞より表面積対体積比が大きい。
体積当たりの交換膜面積が大きくなり、拡散距離も短くなるため物質交換が効率的になる。
parts.modelAnswer: A small cell has a high surface area to volume ratio, providing more membrane area for exchange relative to its volume and shorter diffusion distances.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 小さい細胞は表面積対体積比が大きく、体積に対して交換に使える膜面積が多く、拡散距離も短くなります。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: An enzyme reaction was measured at increasing substrate concentration.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Describe the relationship between substrate concentration and reaction rate.
markscheme: Reaction rate increases as substrate concentration increases at low to moderate substrate concentrations.
The increase becomes smaller and the rate approaches a plateau at high substrate concentration.
markschemeJa: 低〜中程度の基質濃度では、基質濃度が上がると反応速度が上昇する。
高い基質濃度では上昇幅が小さくなり、反応速度は頭打ちに近づく。
parts.modelAnswer: The reaction rate rises rapidly at first as substrate concentration increases, but the increase becomes progressively smaller and the curve approaches a plateau.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 基質濃度が上がると最初は反応速度が大きく上昇しますが、次第に増加幅が小さくなり、最終的に頭打ちに近づきます。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why the reaction rate approaches a plateau at high substrate concentration.
markscheme: At high substrate concentration, most enzyme active sites are occupied for much of the time.
Enzyme concentration becomes limiting, so adding more substrate produces little further increase in rate.
markschemeJa: 高い基質濃度では、多くの酵素活性部位がほとんど常に基質で占有される。
酵素濃度が制限要因となるため、基質を増やしても速度はほとんど上がらない。
parts.modelAnswer: At high substrate concentration, the enzyme becomes saturated because most active sites are occupied. The amount of enzyme then limits the maximum rate.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 高い基質濃度では多くの活性部位が占有され酵素が飽和します。その後は酵素量が制限要因になります。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Predict the effect of a competitive inhibitor at low substrate concentration and at very high substrate concentration.
markscheme: At low substrate concentration, a competitive inhibitor reduces reaction rate because it competes effectively with substrate for active sites.
At very high substrate concentration, the inhibitor effect is reduced because substrate molecules more frequently occupy the active sites.
markschemeJa: 低基質濃度では競争的阻害剤が基質と活性部位を競うため反応速度が低下する。
非常に高い基質濃度では基質が活性部位を占める確率が高くなり、阻害効果は小さくなる。
parts.modelAnswer: The inhibitor has a strong effect at low substrate concentration. At very high substrate concentration, substrate outcompetes the inhibitor more often, so the effect becomes smaller.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 低基質濃度では阻害効果が大きいですが、非常に高い基質濃度では基質が競争に勝ちやすくなり阻害効果は小さくなります。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: A plant heterozygous for a gene with complete dominance was self-crossed. The observed offspring were 148 dominant phenotype and 52 recessive phenotype.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: If 200 offspring are expected in a 3:1 phenotypic ratio, calculate the expected number with the recessive phenotype.
markscheme: 200 × 1 ÷ 4 = 50 offspring.
parts.modelAnswer: A 3:1 ratio predicts one quarter recessive, so 200 × 1 ÷ 4 = 50 recessive offspring.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 3:1では劣性表現型は4分の1なので、200×1÷4＝50個体です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Compare the observed number of recessive offspring with the expected number.
markscheme: The observed value is 52, which is 2 higher than the expected value of 50 and is close to the expectation.
markschemeJa: 観察値52は期待値50より2多く、期待値に近い。
parts.modelAnswer: There were 52 recessive offspring compared with 50 expected, a difference of only 2.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 劣性表現型は期待値50に対して観察値52で、差は2個体です。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how segregation of alleles in meiosis can produce an approximately 3:1 phenotypic ratio in this self-cross.
markscheme: The heterozygous parent produces gametes carrying the dominant allele and recessive allele because the alleles segregate during meiosis.
Random fertilization can produce AA, Aa and aa genotypes in an expected 1:2:1 ratio.
With complete dominance, AA and Aa show the dominant phenotype while aa is recessive, giving an expected 3:1 phenotypic ratio.
markschemeJa: ヘテロ接合体では減数分裂時に2つの対立遺伝子が分離し、優性または劣性対立遺伝子をもつ配偶子ができる。
ランダムな受精によりAA、Aa、aaが期待上1:2:1で生じる。
完全優性ではAAとAaが優性表現型、aaが劣性表現型となるため、表現型比は3:1になる。
parts.modelAnswer: A heterozygote makes gametes carrying either allele because the alleles segregate during meiosis. Random fusion gives an expected 1:2:1 genotype ratio. Complete dominance converts this to an expected 3:1 phenotype ratio.
parts.modelAnswerJa: ヘテロ接合体では減数分裂で対立遺伝子が分離し、ランダム受精で遺伝子型は1:2:1となります。完全優性なら表現型は3:1になります。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Answer all parts about DNA structure and replication.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: State the complementary DNA base to cytosine.
markscheme: Guanine.
markschemeJa: グアニン。
parts.modelAnswer: The complementary base to cytosine is guanine.
parts.modelAnswerJa: シトシンと相補的に塩基対をつくるのはグアニンです。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why DNA replication is described as semi-conservative.
markscheme: The two parental DNA strands separate and each acts as a template for a new complementary strand.
Each daughter DNA molecule contains one parental strand and one newly synthesized strand.
markschemeJa: 親DNAの2本鎖が分離し、それぞれが新しい相補鎖をつくる鋳型になる。
複製後の各DNA分子は親鎖1本と新しく合成された鎖1本を含む。
parts.modelAnswer: The parental strands separate and each directs synthesis of a complementary new strand. Each daughter DNA molecule therefore contains one original strand and one newly synthesized strand.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 親DNAの2本鎖が分かれ、それぞれを鋳型として新しい相補鎖が合成されます。複製後の各DNA分子は親由来の鎖1本と新生鎖1本を含みます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: A DNA molecule contains 30% adenine. Explain the expected percentages of thymine and cytosine in the same double-stranded molecule.
markscheme: Thymine is expected to be 30% because adenine pairs with thymine.
Adenine plus thymine accounts for 60%, leaving 40% for guanine plus cytosine.
Cytosine is expected to be 20% because guanine and cytosine occur in equal proportions in double-stranded DNA.
markschemeJa: アデニンはチミンと対になるので、チミンも30%と予想される。
AとTで60%を占めるため、GとCに残るのは40%である。
二本鎖DNAではGとCの割合が等しいため、シトシンは20%と予想される。
parts.modelAnswer: Thymine should also be 30% because A pairs with T. That leaves 40% for G and C together. Because G pairs with C, they should each make up 20%.
parts.modelAnswerJa: AとTは相補的に対になるためTも30%です。残り40%をGとCが等しく占めるので、Cは20%になります。
